column1: It's perfectly-groomed, over-cologned Lieutenant Joseph Morgan. Despite the fact that he seems to spend a lot of time goofing off, you'd never want his job. Too much political wrangling and brown-nosing the Commissioner.
column2: 這位是打理得一絲不苟、香水濃得過頭的 Joseph Morgan 中尉。雖然他似乎把很多時間花在閒混上，你卻不想做他的工作：政治角力太多，還得對局長逢迎拍馬。

column1: Hello, Lt. Morgan. What do you think? Am I convincing?
column2: Morgan 中尉，你好。你覺得怎樣？我像不像？

column1: Very. Your own mother would have to look twice. How do you feel?
column2: 非常像。就連你親媽都得看兩眼。感覺如何？

column1: Pretty good, sir. I'm ready.
column2: 很好，長官。我準備好了。

column1: You have to be ready, Sonny, and wide awake. You know you'll have to go in without a weapon or a wire. If those men were to catch on you were a cop, they'd kill you in a heartbeat. Understand?
column2: 你必須準備好，Sonny，而且要保持清醒。你知道自己得不帶武器或竊聽線進去吧？要是那些人發現你是警察，他們會在眨眼間殺了你。明白嗎？

column1: Yes, sir, I do.
column2: 明白，長官。

column1: Sonny, I think the importance of this operation is obvious to you. These men are killing innocent kids. They have to be stopped. Remember to keep a level head, though. Rage will only get you killed. These people--if you can call them that--are not to be trifled with. Be sure to check in with me after you've made contact with them.
column2: Sonny，我想你很清楚這次行動的重要性。這些人正在殺害無辜的孩子，必須阻止他們。但記住要保持冷靜，憤怒只會讓你送命。這些人——如果還能稱他們為人——絕不可輕視。和他們接觸後務必回來向我報告。

column1: Yes, sir. I'm going to get them. You can be sure of that.
column2: 是，長官。我會抓到他們，請放心。

column1: Good. Head on over to the hotel, Sonny. Don't let this distract you.
column2: 很好。前往旅館吧，Sonny。別讓這件事分散你的注意力。

column1: Glad to hear it. Well, let's get you started. Your new partner, Detective Laura Watts, is waiting for you in the Narcotics office. She'll get you settled in. I'll call you in later for further briefing.
column2: 很高興聽到這句話。那就開始吧。你的新搭檔 Laura Watts 警探正在緝毒組辦公室等你，她會帶你熟悉環境。稍後我會叫你來接受進一步簡報。

column1: Ah, there you are, Bonds. We were just getting ready to discuss plans for the Delphoria operation. I believe everybody has been introduced, so let's get started.
column2: 啊，你來了，Bonds。我們正準備討論 Delphoria 行動。我想大家都已經互相認識了，那就開始吧。

column1: Bonds, you'll go to the hotel in disguise, using the name of Jimmy Lee "Whitey" Banksten. Marie Wilkans will have already been there for several hours, socializing in the hotel bar. When you reach the hotel, you will rent a room, then go directly to the bar.
column2: Bonds，你要用 Jimmy Lee「Whitey」Banksten 的身分偽裝前往旅館。Marie Wilkans 會先在旅館酒吧交際幾個小時。到達旅館後租一間房，然後直接去酒吧。

column1: Once there, you'll socialize with the bartender. You should buy a drink or two, but I don't have to tell you to keep a clear head. Marie will introduce you to the bartender, Alexandra Parker, whom we suspect of facilitating the illegal gambling. If all goes well, you'll get yourself invited to a "private" poker game.
column2: 到那裡後和酒保交際。你可以買一兩杯酒，但不用我提醒你保持清醒。Marie 會把你介紹給酒保 Alexandra Parker；我們懷疑她協助非法賭博。順利的話，你會受邀參加一場「私人」撲克局。

column1: Once you've infiltrated the game, discover what you can about the narcotics ring, and the identity of the "Death Angel." Be sure to report back to me with any important findings. Think you're up to it, "Whitey"?
column2: 混入賭局後，盡量查出毒品集團的情報，以及「死亡天使」的身分。有重要發現務必回來報告。你做得到嗎，「Whitey」？

column1: Just one question, sir. Why is my nickname supposed to be "Whitey"?
column2: 只有一個問題，長官。為什麼我的綽號要叫「Whitey」？

column1: Hah! I thought you'd never ask, Sonny. Here you go, a bottle of extra-strength peroxide compound for bleaching your hair. Get it, "Whitey?"
column2: 哈！我就知道你不會問，Sonny。給你，這瓶高濃度過氧化物用來漂白頭髮。懂了嗎，「Whitey」？

column1: Oh, it's this white "high-roller" suit hanging on the coat rack over here. Pretty tacky, actually.
column2: 喔，就是掛在這邊衣帽架上的白色「大豪客」套裝。其實俗得可以。

column1: I'm going back to the Narc room. I've got a lot of work to do. Sonny, just put the peroxide in your hair and leave it there for a few minutes. It's pretty strong, so don't leave it there too long. Otherwise we'll be calling you "Baldy" instead of "Whitey."
column2: 我要回緝毒組辦公室，還有很多工作。Sonny，把過氧化物塗在頭髮上，放幾分鐘就好。它很強，別放太久，不然我們就得叫你「禿頭」而不是「Whitey」了。

column1: You'd better get started, Sonny. Go to the locker room and get changed. Don't forget to bleach your hair. Come back here for a quick final briefing before you leave for the hotel.
column2: 你最好開始行動了，Sonny。去更衣室換衣服，別忘了漂白頭髮。離開前回來接受最後的簡報。

column1: Yes, sir. Oh, Lt. Morgan? The dead body in Cotton Cove was Jason Taselli.
column2: 是，長官。對了，Morgan 中尉？Cotton Cove 的死者是 Jason Taselli。

column1: Well...I can't say I'll cry over him, but that means there's somebody worse out there. Go on, Sonny, maybe we'll catch him in the Delphoria operation. Goodbye.
column2: 嗯……我不能說會為他哭泣，但這表示外面還有更糟的人。去吧，Sonny，也許我們能在 Delphoria 行動中抓到他。再見。

column1: You wanted to see me, Lt. Morgan?
column2: Morgan 中尉，你要找我？

column1: Yes. I need you to review some evidence from the Hoffman case, Bonds. Check out the black notebook for clues about this man and his activities, and run an ID check on the gun. There's something very strange about this case. Think you can clarify the picture, Sonny?
column2: 是。我需要你檢視 Hoffman 案的證物，Bonds。查看黑色記事本，找出這個人的活動線索，並查核槍枝身分。這案件很不尋常。你能釐清真相嗎，Sonny？

column1: I'll do my best, sir.
column2: 我會盡力，長官。

column1: Well, have at it, detective.
column2: 那就開始吧，警探。

column1: Sonny, we're all upset by this, but don't let it affect you. You have to get going.
column2: Sonny，我們都為此難過，但別讓它影響你。你必須繼續行動。

column1: Get moving, Sonny!
column2: 快行動，Sonny！

column1: Report to the Narcotics office immediately, Bonds. We don't have time to waste.
column2: Bonds，立刻到緝毒組辦公室報到。我們沒有時間浪費。

column1: Let's go, Bonds. You don't need an engraved invitation to the Evidence room.
column2: 走吧，Bonds。去證物室不需要刻字邀請函。

column1: Oh, hello, Sonny. Yes, I wanted to talk to you about Marie Wilkans. You possibly know her as "Sweet Cheeks" Marie.
column2: 喔，你好，Sonny。我想和你談談 Marie Wilkans。你可能知道她叫「Sweet Cheeks」Marie。

column1: She evidently knows you, too, and thinks rather highly of you. Anyway, she's been arrested for soliciting. We'd like you to approach her with a "deal".
column2: 顯然她也認識你，而且對你評價很高。總之，她因拉客被捕。我們希望你帶著一筆「交易」去找她。

column1: We're going to be starting an undercover operation at the Hotel Delphoria. We want to infiltrate the narcotics ring by way of the illegal gambling that goes on there. We know Marie Wilkans has connections at the Delphoria.
column2: 我們要在 Delphoria 旅館展開臥底行動，透過那裡的非法賭博滲透毒品集團。我們知道 Marie Wilkans 在 Delphoria 有人脈。

column1: We think Marie Wilkans can get us in there. In return, we'll do our best to get the charges dropped. I need you to go to the jail and discuss this with her, Bonds. Give her a minimum of information. We don't want her endangered, but we think she can help us. Any questions?
column2: 我們認為 Marie Wilkans 能帶我們進去。作為交換，我們會盡力撤銷控罪。Bonds，你要去監獄和她談這件事。只給她最低限度的資訊。我們不想讓她陷入危險，但相信她能幫忙。有問題嗎？

column1: Sonny. You're doing an excellent job. There's an opening in narcotics that I think you should apply for. Fill out a transfer request form down on the first floor by the elevator, and I'll see what I can do.
column2: Sonny，你做得非常好。緝毒科有個職缺，我希望你申請。到一樓電梯旁填寫調職申請，我會看看能幫你什麼。

column1: Detective Laura Watts. A cheerful, no-nonsense Narcotics officer who plays the book.
column2: Laura Watts 警探。一位開朗、務實、照規章辦事的緝毒警官。

column1: Oh, hi, Sonny. Or should I say,"Detective Bonds"? Congratulations on the transfer. I know it's only temporary, but if you do good work, we'll probably ask to keep you. Come on, I'll give you a tour of the office.
column2: 喔，嗨，Sonny。還是該叫你「Bonds 警探」？恭喜調職。我知道只是暫時的，但如果你表現良好，我們可能會要求留下你。來，我帶你參觀辦公室。

column1: Thanks, Detective Watts.
column2: 謝謝你，Watts 警探。

column1: Call me Laura. This is the key board. Or, in a room full of computers, I guess I should just call it the keyholder to avoid confusion. Anyway, we hang our vehicle keys here.
column2: 叫我 Laura。這是鑰匙板。在滿是電腦的房間裡，為免混淆，應該叫它鑰匙架。不管怎樣，車輛鑰匙都掛在這裡。

column1: Our call number here is 83-NORA-10. That's about it for the Grand Tour of the Narcotics Office. Okay, let's get down to business!
column2: 我們這裡的呼號是 83-NORA-10。緝毒組辦公室大致就參觀到這裡。好了，進入正題！

column1: This creep Hoffman is on the verge of being released on bail. We suspect he's tied in with much bigger things than just the narcotics found in the trunk of the stolen car. He claims they were there when he "borrowed" it, of course.
column2: 這個 Hoffman 就快要交保釋放了。我們懷疑他牽涉的事情遠不只是失竊車後車廂裡的毒品。他當然聲稱那些東西在他「借」車時就已經在裡面。

column1: We know damn well if he's released, he'll bolt like a rabbit. We need some hard evidence to keep him in. See if you can dig anything up that might convince Judge Palmer to keep the jerk locked up, okay? I've gotta go. Do your best, Sonny. Bye.
column2: 我們很清楚，他一旦獲釋就會像兔子一樣逃掉。我們需要確鑿證據把他留下。看看能否挖出足以說服 Palmer 法官繼續羈押這混蛋的東西，好嗎？我得走了。盡力而為，Sonny。再見。

column1: Wow. Your first Narcotics investigation. You wonder where you should start.
column2: 哇，你第一次進行緝毒調查。你想著該從哪裡開始。

column1: You look through the files until you find Hoffman, Marvin. You carefully take the file out and read it.
column2: 你翻閱檔案，直到找到 Marvin Hoffman。你小心取出檔案閱讀。

column1: Hoffman, Marvin. Sex:M 6'0" Hair:Blk Eyes:Blue Wt:193 DOB 02-06-61 Distinguishing Marks: Rose tattoo over left nipple. Outstanding Warrants: Armed Robbery, Grand Theft Auto, Suspected Murder 1.
column2: Hoffman，Marvin。性別：男，身高 6 呎，黑髮，藍眼，體重 193 磅，出生日期 1961-02-06。特徵：左乳頭上方有玫瑰刺青。未執行逮捕令：持械搶劫、重大竊車、涉嫌一級謀殺。

column1: Prior Convictions: Grand Theft Auto, Aggravated Assault, Possesion of Cocaine Incarceration: 5 years+5 years parole
column2: 前科：重大竊車、加重攻擊、持有可卡因。刑期：五年，附五年假釋。

column1: You take Hoffman's file with you.
column2: 你帶著 Hoffman 的檔案。
